title: "eFootball"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
---

My eFootball national-team squads for top 50 FIFA Men’s World Ranking
nations. Squads are generated by my
[efootball](https://github.com/WKaiZ/efootball) project and this page refreshes
automatically every day. 

```{=html}
<style>
  .ef-wrap { --ef-card-bg:#fff; --ef-card-br:#e6e8eb; --ef-muted:#6b7280;
             --ef-accent:#2c6bed; --ef-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
             --ef-chip:#eef2f7; --ef-photo-bg:#f1f3f6; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .ef-wrap { --ef-card-bg:#1c2128; --ef-card-br:#30363d; --ef-muted:#9aa4b2;
               --ef-accent:#4f8cff; --ef-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
               --ef-chip:#262c34; --ef-photo-bg:#e9edf2; }
  }
  .ef-wrap { margin-top:.5rem; }
  .ef-meta { color:var(--ef-muted); font-size:.85rem; margin-bottom:1rem; }
  .ef-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.4rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; }
  .ef-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; cursor:pointer;
            border:1px solid var(--ef-card-br); background:var(--ef-card-bg);
            border-radius:999px; padding:.35rem .8rem; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1;
            transition:all .12s ease; color:inherit; }
  .ef-tab:hover { border-color:var(--ef-accent); }
  .ef-tab.active { background:var(--ef-accent); border-color:var(--ef-accent); color:#fff; }
  .ef-tab .flag { font-size:1.05rem; }
  .ef-section-title { font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600; margin:1.5rem 0 .7rem;
                      display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.5rem; }
  .ef-section-title .count { color:var(--ef-muted); font-weight:400; font-size:.85rem; }
  .ef-grid { display:grid; gap:.8rem; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr)); }
  .ef-card { position:relative; background:var(--ef-card-bg); border:1px solid var(--ef-card-br);
             border-radius:14px; padding:.55rem; box-shadow:var(--ef-shadow); text-align:center;
             transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  .ef-card:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }
  .ef-photo { position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; margin:0 auto .5rem;
             border-radius:10px; background:var(--ef-photo-bg); overflow:hidden;
             display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .ef-photo img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:top center; }
  .ef-photo .ef-initials { font-size:1.7rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ef-muted); }
  .ef-num { position:absolute; top:.35rem; left:.4rem; z-index:2; font-weight:700; font-size:.7rem;
             color:#fff; background:rgba(0,0,0,.55); border-radius:6px; padding:.06rem .3rem; }
  .ef-rating { position:absolute; top:.35rem; right:.4rem; z-index:2; font-weight:700; font-size:.7rem;
             background:var(--ef-accent); color:#fff; border-radius:6px; padding:.06rem .32rem;
             box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
  .ef-days .ef-medal { font-size:.9rem; margin-right:.15rem; vertical-align:-1px; }
  .ef-card.ef-ranked { border-color:var(--ef-accent); }
  .ef-card.ef-ranked .ef-days { color:var(--ef-accent); font-weight:600; }
  .ef-name { font-weight:600; font-size:.88rem; line-height:1.2; min-height:2.2em;
             display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .ef-pos { display:inline-block; margin-top:.3rem; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:600;
            border-radius:6px; padding:.1rem .42rem; background:var(--ef-chip); color:var(--ef-muted); }
  .ef-pos[data-line="GK"]  { background:#fde9c8; color:#8a5a00; }
  .ef-pos[data-line="DEF"] { background:#d6ecff; color:#0b5cad; }
  .ef-pos[data-line="MID"] { background:#dcf5e3; color:#1f7a3d; }
  .ef-pos[data-line="FWD"] { background:#ffe0e0; color:#b02121; }
  .ef-days { margin-top:.35rem; font-size:.68rem; color:var(--ef-muted); }
  .ef-wild .ef-card { border-color:var(--ef-accent); }
  .ef-loading, .ef-error { color:var(--ef-muted); padding:2rem 0; }
</style>

<div class="ef-wrap">
  <div class="ef-meta" id="ef-meta"></div>
  <div class="ef-tabs" id="ef-tabs"></div>
  <div id="ef-squad"><div class="ef-loading">Loading squads…</div></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const LINE = { GK:["GK"], DEF:["CB","LB","RB","LWB","RWB"],
                 MID:["DMF","CMF","AMF","LMF","RMF"], FWD:["CF","SS","LWF","RWF"] };
  const lineOf = (p) => Object.keys(LINE).find(k => LINE[k].includes(p)) || "MID";
  const MEDAL = { 1:"🥇", 2:"🥈", 3:"🥉" };

  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c =>
    ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]));
  const initials = (n) => n.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join("").toUpperCase();
  const daysSince = (iso) => Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso+"T00:00:00Z"))/86400000));
  const photoHTML = (p) => p.img
    ? `<img loading="lazy" src="${esc(p.img)}" alt="${esc(p.name)}"
         onerror="this.outerHTML='<span class=&quot;ef-initials&quot;>${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>'">`
    : `<span class="ef-initials">${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>`;

  function card(p) {
    const medal = p.tenureRank ? `<span class="ef-medal">${MEDAL[p.tenureRank]}</span>` : "";
    const tip = `${p.name} · ${p.pos} · rating ${p.rating.toFixed(0)} · in squad since ${p.since}`;
    return `<div class="ef-card${p.tenureRank ? " ef-ranked" : ""}" title="${esc(tip)}">
      <div class="ef-photo">
        ${photoHTML(p)}
        <span class="ef-num">#${p.number}</span>
        <span class="ef-rating">${p.rating.toFixed(0)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ef-name">${esc(p.name)}</div>
      <div><span class="ef-pos" data-line="${lineOf(p.pos)}">${esc(p.pos)}</span></div>
      <div class="ef-days">${medal}${daysSince(p.since)}d in squad</div>
    </div>`;
  }

  function section(title, players, extra) {
    if (!players.length) return "";
    return `<div class="ef-section ${extra||''}">
      <div class="ef-section-title">${title}<span class="count">${players.length}</span></div>
      <div class="ef-grid">${players.map(card).join("")}</div></div>`;
  }

  function renderSquad(c) {
    const byS = (s) => c.players.filter(p => p.section === s);
    document.getElementById("ef-squad").innerHTML =
      section("Starters", byS("starters")) +
      section("Substitutes", byS("substitutes")) +
      section("Wildcard", byS("wildcard"), "ef-wild");
  }

  fetch("assets/efootball/squads.json?v=" + Date.now())
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(data => {
      const countries = data.countries || [];
      document.getElementById("ef-meta").innerHTML =
        `Updated ${esc(data.updated || "")} · source: ` +
        `<a href="${esc(data.source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WKaiZ/efootball</a>`;
      const tabs = document.getElementById("ef-tabs");
      tabs.innerHTML = countries.map((c,i) =>
        `<span class="ef-tab${i===0?' active':''}" data-i="${i}">
           <span class="flag">${c.flag||''}</span>${esc(c.name)}</span>`).join("");
      tabs.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const t = e.target.closest(".ef-tab"); if (!t) return;
        tabs.querySelectorAll(".ef-tab").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
        t.classList.add("active");
        renderSquad(countries[+t.dataset.i]);
      });
      if (countries.length) renderSquad(countries[0]);
      else document.getElementById("ef-squad").innerHTML = `<div class="ef-error">No squads available.</div>`;
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("ef-squad").innerHTML =
        `<div class="ef-error">Couldn't load squads (${esc(err.message)}).</div>`;
    });
})();
</script>
```
